steps.title: Tick extended streaming history, not just account data
steps.detail: This is the important step. Account data covers the past year only. Extended streaming history covers the entire life of the account.

steps.title: Confirm from the email
steps.detail: Nothing starts until you click the link.

steps.title: Wait
steps.detail: Spotify quotes thirty days for both. In practice the extended history has often arrived faster than the standard package.

steps.title: Download and keep the zip
steps.detail: Playlists, library, search history and every stream you have ever played are inside.

notes: What the default request leaves out, and it is most of it: the standard download covers roughly the last year of listening. Everything before that is Extended streaming history, which is a separate tick on the same page and is answered on a completely different timescale - days for the standard one, weeks for the extended. If you want your listening history rather than your recent listening, tick it, and expect to wait. Spotify has also had spells where extended history came back with streams missing the identifiers that say which track was played, which makes those rows unusable; if yours looks like that, request it again rather than assuming that is all there is.
The two packages are requested together but arrive separately, sometimes days apart. It is easy to open the first one and assume that is all there is.
Files are numbered with a counter that never resets, and sorting them alphabetically puts part 10 before part 2.
A field recording whether a track was skipped was not populated at all between 2015 and late 2022.

faq.q: How do I get my full Spotify listening history?
faq.a: Tick extended streaming history when you request. The default account data package only covers the last twelve months; the extended one covers everything since you opened the account.

faq.q: How long does a Spotify data request take?
faq.a: Spotify says up to thirty days. Reports vary from a few hours to about a week, and the extended history has often arrived before the standard package.

faq.q: What is in a Spotify extended streaming history?
faq.a: Every track you have played, with the timestamp, how many milliseconds you listened for, the device platform and why playback started and stopped.
